body: Build 0101. G-001: Mandraccio harbor, Genoa, ~1090-1112 CE. WITNESS-LONG 22yr, 97ft. FAREWELL-A — first since Córdoba, full restoration. Tyler watched First Crusade mustering. Gap reconstructed: Córdoba→Toledo→Genoa. 15yr interval (1112-1127 CE) subject retains: 'something I remember more clearly.' He is choosing when to disclose. Season finale pending.
title: S09E04: Genoa confirmed — 97ft, WITNESS-LONG, FAREWELL-A restored, 15yr undisclosed interval
